instructions.supplier: Which line holds the name of the company that issued this invoice?
instructions.number: Which line holds the invoice number?
instructions.date: Which line holds the invoice date?
instructions.total: Which line holds the FINAL total of the invoice (what has to be paid)? The right line STARTS with 'Amount due' or 'Total' and ENDS with the amount or currency code (e.g. 'Amount due $50.00 USD', 'Total $50.00'), or it is the big amount standing alone (e.g. '$200.00', '$50.00 USD', 'US$10.00'). The right line contains NO month name and NO year. A line that continues after the amount with 'due' + month + day + year is WRONG even though it shows the right amount: the year 2026 would be booked as the amount. Pick another line with the SAME amount instead. Never a line-item price, unit price, usage amount or subtotal.
instructions.date_order: How is the invoice date written?
instructions.currency: Which currency is the invoice total in? Judge by the currency symbol or code printed on the invoice.
instructions.category: Which expense item fits what was bought?

category_criteria.AI Models & API: AI models, AI subscriptions, inference or generation credits.
category_criteria.Developer Tools: APIs, SDKs and tools used by developers.

hints: TOTAL TRAP 1 (Anthropic invoices 74 and 78, and 5 times before; also Pinecone): Jev chose the line that starts with the amount and goes on '... USD due <month> <day>, 2026'. The engine then takes 2026 as the amount and the invoice is booked as $2,026.00 = FAILED. Choose the line with the same amount and no date: 'Amount due $200.00 USD', 'Total $200.00', '$200.00 USD' or '$200.00'.

CHECK before answering total: does your line contain a month name (January ... December) or '2026'? Then it is the wrong line. Pick a different line that shows the same dollar amount without any date.
An invoice total of 2026.00 is never right: it is the year. These suppliers' totals are small (10.00, 29.00, 99.00, 199.00, 200.00).

TOTAL TRAP 2 (Pinecone, invoice 59): Jev picked '$49.87', a line-item/subtotal amount, and the invoice was booked wrong. When the invoice shows several different amounts, do NOT take a line-item, usage or subtotal figure. Take the amount of the 'Amount due' / 'Total' line.

A stray letter in front of the total (e.g. 'N258.42', 'D258.42') is a mis-read currency symbol, not a dollar sign. It is most likely the shekel sign (ILS). Look for other lines with a currency code before choosing USD.
'US$' before the amount means USD. A plain '$' usually means USD, except for WellyBox.
WellyBox invoices (total 258.42) are in ILS: the shekel sign gets mis-read as 'N', 'D', '~' or '$'. Choose ILS for WellyBox unless a line clearly says USD.

enter.kind_instructions: You enter one supplier invoice into the accounting app, one action at a time. The blank form ('New Entry', 'Draft') is already open, nothing is focused. Typing only works if your immediately previous action was a click_item on that input. Order: click lower 'Supplier' -> type_supplier -> click the date line ONCE -> type_date (the engine then clicks '+ Add Row' for you) -> then decide by the ITEM ROW at y≈472: (a) its first cell reads '× Item' or 'X Item' = item NOT entered yet: click_item on that '× Item' line; if your last action was exactly that click -> type_item. (b) the first cell shows the item name and the cell below 'Rate' reads '$ 0.00' -> click_item on it, once. (c) item name present, the cell below 'Rate' reads '0.00' without '$' and your last action was the click on it -> type_amount (the engine then clicks 'Save' for you). (d) popup 'Create new Purchase Invoice entry?' -> 'Yes' -> 'Submit' -> 'Yes'. If there is NO row at y≈472 after the date, click '+ Add Row' once yourself. While '× Item' is visible NEVER click '$ 0.00' or '0.00' and never choose type_amount. Never choose type_amount when the last action was type_item, press_return or type_amount. Never click the same line again after it changed nothing.
enter.item_instructions: If clicking is the right move, which on-screen line should be clicked? Blank form: the LOWER 'Supplier' (x≈917 y≈213), not the label at y≈181. While the row shows '× Item' / 'X Item' (x≈631 y≈472): click THAT line, it is the item input. Do not click the column header 'Item' (643,422), and do not click '$ 0.00' or '0.00' yet. Only when the item name stands in the row: click the '$ 0.00' whose below is 'Rate' (x≈976 y≈472), not the '$ 0.00' below 'Amount' (x≈1074) and not the '$0.00' at x≈815 (Net/Grand Total). In a popup click its button (Yes / No / Okay / Submit). Never click column headers (y≈422), the sidebar, the 'Purchase Invoice' title, the top 'Create' button, calendar day numbers, '+ Add Row' when a row already exists at y≈472, the date line once it shows the invoice date, or a line you already clicked with no effect.

kinds.click_item: Click one of the on-screen lines: a button (Save, Submit, Yes, No, Okay, and '+ Add Row' only if no item row exists yet), an input to focus it (lower 'Supplier', the date line, the row's '× Item' placeholder, the row's '$ 0.00' below 'Rate'), or a dropdown option. First action on the blank form: lower 'Supplier'. When the row at y≈472 shows '× Item': click that line. WRONG: clicking '0.00' (no '$') below Rate again, it is already focused.
kinds.type_supplier: Type the supplier name. ONLY if your immediately previous action was click_item on the lower 'Supplier' line (y≈213). WRONG as the first action, WRONG after press_return, WRONG after a type_supplier that changed nothing. Return is pressed automatically afterwards.
kinds.type_date: Type the invoice date. Choose this right after ONE click on the date line under 'Date', when the calendar popup (month name + year, day numbers, 'Clear', 'Today') is open and the line reads like '19/09/2026, 15:39:09'. The popup is closed and the date typed for you, and '+ Add Row' is clicked for you right after.
kinds.type_item: Type the expense item name. ONLY if your immediately previous action was click_item on the row's '× Item' / 'X Item' line (x≈631 y≈472). WRONG after clicking the header 'Item' (y≈422) or after clicking '$ 0.00' / '0.00': the item does not get entered and Return scrolls the page (invoices 45, 46, 50). Return is pressed automatically afterwards.
kinds.type_amount: Type the invoice amount. ONLY if the item name already stands in the row (no '× Item' on screen) AND your immediately previous action was click_item on the row's cell below 'Rate' (it now reads '0.00' without '$', x≈981 y≈472). WRONG if your previous action was type_item, press_return or type_amount. Never twice in a row. Tab and a click on 'Save' follow automatically.
kinds.press_return: Press Return to confirm the highlighted dropdown option, only if a dropdown with the typed value is still open and the value is not yet in the field. Not needed after type_supplier/type_item: it is pressed for you.
kinds.press_tab: Press Tab to leave a field after its value is visibly on screen. Do not use Tab to find fields.
kinds.press_escape: Press Escape to close a menu that is blocking the form. Do NOT use it on the date calendar before type_date, and do not use it on Yes/No or Okay popups: click their button instead.
kinds.scroll_down: Scroll down, only if a needed button or field is not among the screen lines.
kinds.scroll_up: Scroll up when the form is scrolled down: the lines 'Number Series', 'Supplier', 'Date' are missing and 'Add Row' stands near y≈203 with 'Net Total' at y≈253. Then continue with the item row.
kinds.wait: The screen is still changing; wait.
kinds.done: Only when the invoice was saved AND submitted: the form no longer shows 'Draft', 'New Entry' or 'Not Submitted' and shows the supplier and the correct Grand Total. Never while Grand Total is $0.00 or a popup is open.

hints: STEP 1: the blank form ('New Entry', 'Draft') is open and NO field is focused. First action = click_item on the LOWER 'Supplier' line (x≈917 y≈213; the label at y≈181 does nothing). Only then type_supplier. If you see a list screen instead, click 'Make Entry'.
TRAP: type_supplier as the first action types into nothing (screen_changed=False, placeholder 'Supplier' stays at y≈213). If that happened, click the lower 'Supplier' line now, then type_supplier.

After type_supplier the engine presses Return itself. The supplier is entered when its name stands at y≈213 and Account shows 'Creditors'. A leftover dropdown (name + 'Create' at y≈262-296) closes with your next click. Do not retype, do not click 'Create'.

DATE: once the supplier name stands at y≈213 and 'Creditors' shows, click the line 'Sep 19, 2026 ...' (x≈957 y≈290) ONCE, even if the 'Date' label is hidden by the leftover dropdown. No scrolling. A calendar opens, the line becomes '19/09/2026, ...'. The very next action MUST be type_date.
The date is entered when the line reads like '26/06/2026, ...' or 'Jun 26, 2026 ...' matching the invoice date. Then NEVER click the date line again: it only reopens the calendar.

ADD ROW IS AUTOMATIC: right after type_date the engine clicks '+ Add Row'. You then see a row at y≈472: 'X Item', 'Tax', '1', '$ 0.00', '$0.00', with '+ Add Row' at y≈520. Do NOT click Add Row then (a second row breaks every save). Only if NO row exists at y≈472, click '+ Add Row' once.

ITEM FIRST: when the row shows '× Item' (OCR may read 'X Item'; x≈631 y≈472), click that line. That is the row's item input. NOT the header 'Item' at 643,422 and NOT '$ 0.00'. A dropdown with the item names opens; then type_item.
RULE: while a line '× Item' / 'X Item' is on screen, the item is NOT entered. The only right moves are: click '× Item', then type_item. Everything about Rate and amount comes later.

TRAP (invoices 42-50, 8 of 8 died): Jev clicked '$ 0.00' below 'Rate' while the row still showed '× Item', then clicked the '0.00' 4-7 more times with no effect. Do not touch the Rate cell before the item name is in the row.

TRAP (invoices 45, 46, 50): click on the header 'Item' (643,422) then type_item: the item was NOT entered ('× Item' stayed in the row) and Return scrolled the page. type_item only after a click on '× Item'.

After type_item + Return the item name replaces '× Item' in the row at y≈472 (OCR shows fragments like 'Is & AP!', 'Is & API >', 'er Tools', 'scription', 'Al Mode'); a small dropdown (same name, 'Create') may stay open below. The cursor is STILL in the Item cell. Do not type now.

NEXT after the item name appears: click_item ONCE on the '$0.00' / '$ 0.00' whose below is 'Rate' (x≈976 y≈472). The cell turns into '0.00' without '$' (x≈981): that means it is focused. Next action = type_amount. Do NOT click '0.00' again.

Rate and Amount cells both read '$ 0.00' at y≈472: Rate is x≈976 with below='Rate', Amount is x≈1074 with below='Amount' (do not click). The '$0.00' at x≈815 belongs to Net/Grand Total: never click it.

TRAP: type_amount right after type_item/press_return writes the digits into the Item cell ('SaaS Subscription4', 'Cloud & Hosting25.'). Grand Total stays $0.00 and the save fails. Always click the Rate cell in between.
Never choose type_amount twice in a row. If Grand Total is still $0.00 after type_amount, click the row's cell below 'Rate' once, then type_amount once.

SAVE IS AUTOMATIC: after type_amount the engine presses Tab and clicks 'Save'. Next you see the popup 'Save New Purchase Invoice NN?' -> click 'Yes'. If instead the Draft form is still shown with Grand Total equal to the invoice amount, click 'Save' (1302,67) yourself.
Click 'Save' yourself only when the row's item name is CLEAN (no digits glued to it, no '× Item') and Grand Total shows the invoice amount.

Save popup 'Save New Purchase Invoice NN?' + 'Create new Purchase Invoice entry?' with 'Yes' (794,481) and 'No': if plain, click 'Yes'. If it also says 'Entry has Grand Total $0.00. Please verify amounts', click 'No', then click the row's cell below 'Rate', then type_amount.

Popup 'Not Found - Item value <name><digits> does not exist': click 'Okay'. The Item cell is corrupted. Do NOT click Save again. Repair: click the corrupted name in the row, click the clean item name in the dropdown below, then Rate cell, then type_amount.
Popup 'Mandatory Error - Value missing for Items Row 2': click 'Okay'; an empty second row exists (y≈520, with an '×' at its left). Try clicking that '×' to remove it. Never click 'Add Row' again.

After 'Yes' the title becomes 'PINV-10NN', the state reads 'Not Submitted' and 'Submit' stands at the top right (1298,67): click it, then click 'Yes' in the popup 'Submit PINV-10NN?' / 'Mark Purchase Invoice as submitted?'. Saving alone does not count. 'Not Submitted' on screen = not done.

SCROLLED FORM: if 'Number Series', 'Supplier' and 'Date' are missing and you see 'Add Row' near y≈203, 'Net Total' y≈253, 'References', 'Notes', the form is scrolled down. Choose scroll_up. Do not click '$0.00' at 815,285.

Never click the 'Purchase Invoice' title, the top 'Create' button (x≈1227 or 1169, y≈67), or sidebar lines (Dashboard, Sales, Purchases, Suppliers, Purchase Items, Common, Reports, Setup). In popups click the button line; after 'Okay' on an error, FIX it before the next Save.

If your last action shows screen_changed=False, or you already clicked the same line twice, choose something DIFFERENT: after a type_* that changed nothing, click the field; after a useless click, a different line or the matching type_* action.
Do not use press_tab to hunt for fields: focus is invisible and values typed that way never landed. Click the field you want.
